dorsal_wing_plumage_topography.flight_feather_edge_geometry: High-contrast, bold white spots along the edges of the dark flight feathers create a sharp, fragmented boundary against the charcoal-gray body.

crown_and_nape_macro_patterns.nape_patch_geometry: A distinct, roughly circular/oval patch of rufous-brown feathers is centered on the posterior crown and nape area.

other_distinctive_markers: Bold, high-contrast white spotting/barring on the tail feathers matches the pattern found on the wing flight feathers.
